Problem: सतत विकास के सामाजिक, आर्थिक और पर्यावरणीय आयामों की अविभाज्यता पर जोर देते हुए, सतत विकास के लक्ष्यों में वैश्विक, राष्ट्रीय और स्थानीय स्तरों पर समावेशी नीतियों और प्रथाओं की वकालत की गई है। अपनी गैर-बाध्यकारी प्रकृति के बावजूद, सतत विकास लक्ष्यों ने वैश्विक बहसों, नीतिगत एजेंडा और संस्थागत प्राथमिकताओं को प्रभावित किया है, हालांकि परिवर्तनकारी परिवर्तन सीमित हैं। 2030 तक इन महत्वाकांक्षी लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करने के लिए सहयोगी वित्तपोषण, तकनीकी नवाचार और मजबूत वैश्विक भागीदारी महत्वपूर्ण हैं।
Solution:
सतत विकास के एजेंडे 2030 को लोगों, ग्रह और समृद्धि के लिए एक व्यापक कार्य योजना के रूप में संदर्भित किया जाता है। यह सतत विकास के तीन स्तंभों सामाजिक, पर्यावरणीय और आर्थिक से सीधे संबंधित है। यह 17 लक्ष्यों, 168 लक्ष्यों और प्रगति को मापने के लिए 230 से अधिक संकेतकों से बना है। लक्ष्य सभी के लिए बेहतर और अधिक टिकाऊ भविष्य प्राप्त करने का खाका हैं। वे गरीबी, असमानता, जलवायु परिवर्तन, पर्यावरणीय गिरावट, शांति और न्याय सहित हमारे सामने आने वाली वैश्विक चुनौतियों का समाधान करते हैं।
 
 पिछले कुछ साल पूरी दुनिया के लिए बुरे सपने की तरह थे। खास तौर पर कोविड-19 हमारे लिए समाज के कंकालों में दरारों को उजागर करने वाले एक्स-रे की तरह रहा है। इसने हमें एहसास दिलाया है कि हम जिस रास्ते पर चल रहे थे, वह हमें कहीं नहीं ले जा रहा है, हमें अपना रास्ता बदलना होगा। अगर एक बात पक्की है तो वह यह है कि हमें अभी कार्रवाई करने की जरूरत है और विंस्टन चर्चिल ने एक बार कहा था, "कभी भी किसी संकट को व्यर्थ न जाने दें" और यह 2030 के एजेंडे पर भी लागू होता है। हमें अभी तुरंत कार्रवाई करने की जरूरत है।
 
 कोविड-19 महामा
problem_translated: Emphasizing the indivisibility of the social, economic, and environmental dimensions of sustainable development, the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) advocate for inclusive policies and practices at global, national, and local levels. Despite their non-binding nature, the SDGs have influenced global debates, policy agendas, and institutional priorities, although transformative changes have been limited. Collaborative financing, technological innovation, and strong global partnerships are crucial to achieving these ambitious goals by 2030.
solution_translated:
The 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development is referred to as a comprehensive action plan for people, planet, and prosperity. It is directly related to the three pillars of sustainable development: social, environmental, and economic. It consists of 17 goals, 168 targets, and over 230 indicators to measure progress. The goals are a blueprint to achieve a better and more sustainable future for all. They address the global challenges we face, including poverty, inequality, climate change, environmental degradation, peace, and justice.

The last few years have been like a nightmare for the entire world. Especially, COVID-19 has been like an X-ray for us, exposing the cracks in the skeletons of society. It has made us realize that the path we were on was leading us nowhere; we need to change our direction. If one thing is certain, it is that we need to act now, and as Winston Churchill once said, "Never let a good crisis go to waste," and this also applies to the 2030 Agenda. We need to take immediate action now.

COVID-19 pandemic
summarization: The problem highlights that despite the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) influencing global agendas, transformative change has been limited, and achieving these ambitious goals by 2030 requires collaborative financing, technological innovation, and strong global partnerships. The solution describes the 2030 Agenda as a comprehensive action plan for a sustainable future, emphasizing that recent crises like the COVID-19 pandemic underscore the urgent need for immediate action and a change in approach to achieve these goals.

Problem: हमारे घर के बगल के एक व्यक्ति जिनका पुत्र बाहर में काम कर कुछ धनराशि अपने बहन की शादी के लिए अपने पिता को ऑनलाइन भेजा। परंतु उनके पिता से साइबर फ्रॉड ने सारी धनराशि निकालना लीं।
Solution:
ऑनलाइन सुरक्षा के लिए सुझाव
 1. अनजाने लिंक पर क्लिक न करें: अज्ञात स्रोतों से आए ईमेल या संदेशों में दिए गए लिंक पर क्लिक करने से बचें। ये लिंक आपके डिवाइस में मैलवेयर डाल सकते हैं या आपकी व्यक्तिगत जानकारी चोरी कर सकते हैं।
 2. व्यक्तिगत जानकारी साझा न करें: अपनी व्यक्तिगत जानकारी, जैसे कि आपका बैंक खाता नंबर, क्रेडिट कार्ड नंबर, या पासवर्ड, किसी के साथ भी साझा न करें।
 3. सुरक्षित वेबसाइटों का उपयोग करें: ऑनलाइन लेनदेन करते समय, सुनिश्चित करें कि आप एक सुरक्षित वेबसाइट पर हैं। वेबसाइट के URL में "https" और एक ताला की छवि देखें।
 4. पासवर्ड को मजबूत रखें: अपने ऑनलाइन खातों के लिए मजबूत और अनोखे पासवर्ड का उपयोग करें। अपने पासवर्ड को नियमित रूप से बदलना भी एक अच्छा विचार है।
 5. ऑनलाइन लेनदेन की निगरानी करें: अपने बैंक खातों और क्रेडिट कार्ड खातों की निगरानी करें और किसी भी अनहोनी या असामान्य गतिविधि की सूचना तुरंत अपने बैंक या क्रेडिट कार्ड कंपनी को दें।
problem_translated: A person living next to our house had his son working abroad, who sent some money online to his father for his sister's wedding. However, a cyber fraudster took all the money from his father.
solution_translated:
Tips for online safety
 1. Do not click on unknown links: Avoid clicking on links in emails or messages from unknown sources. These links can install malware on your device or steal your personal information.
 2. Do not share personal information: Do not share your personal information, such as your bank account number, credit card number, or password, with anyone.
 3. Use secure websites: When making online transactions, ensure that you are on a secure website. Look for "https" and a padlock image in the website's URL.
 4. Keep passwords strong: Use strong and unique passwords for your online accounts. It is also a good idea to change your passwords regularly.
 5. Monitor online transactions: Monitor your bank accounts and credit card accounts and immediately report any unusual or abnormal activity to your bank or credit card company.
summarization: The problem describes a cyber fraud incident where a father lost money sent by his son for a wedding. The proposed solution offers five key tips for online safety, including avoiding unknown links, not sharing personal information, using secure websites, maintaining strong passwords, and monitoring online transactions to prevent such frauds.

problem_translated:
Network problem:
1. In most interior areas, we face network-related problems.
2. In rural areas, mostly BSNL towers are installed, which provide 2G network, making it difficult to watch videos properly.
3. In some sensitive areas, network problems persist due to Naxalism (Maoist insurgency).

Economic problem:
1. Most children do not have multimedia mobile phones available because their family's economic situation is weak.
2. Even if someone has a mobile, they are unable to recharge it on time.
3. Due to increasing recharge rates, many children are unable to recharge.

Misuse of internet:
1. Some children misuse the internet even after having all facilities available.
2. Due to spending too much time on the internet, they are giving less time to their families, which is increasing distances (straining relationships).
solution_translated:
1. In remote areas where there is a network problem, a collective application has been submitted to the Department of Telecommunications for installing new towers.
2. Parents should encourage their children to study according to their interests.
3. Children should be taught how to use the internet properly.
4. Children below the poverty line should receive free internet service.
5. Mobile recharge rates should be reduced.
summarization: The submission highlights network issues in rural and sensitive areas, economic barriers preventing children from accessing or recharging mobile phones, and the misuse of the internet. The proposed solutions include installing new network towers, promoting proper internet usage, providing free internet to underprivileged children, reducing mobile recharge rates, and encouraging parents to support their children's interests.

Problem: दृष्टिहीन व्यक्तियों के लिए चश्मा का विकास एक महत्वपूर्ण तकनीकी कदम है । जिसमें अल्ट्रासोनिक सेंसर का उपयोग किया जा रहा है । यह चश्मा उन्हें अपने आस - पास की वस्तुओं का सही आकलन करने में मदद करता है खासकर उन परिस्थितियों में जहां दृष्टि की कमी होती है । अल्ट्रासोनिक सेंसर की मदद से यह चश्मा ध्वनि तरंगों का उपयोग करके वातावरण को समझता है और उपयोगकर्ता को रियल - टाइम से वस्तुओं की स्थिति और दूरी के बारे में सूचित करता है । अल्ट्रासोनिक सेंसर उच्च आवृत्ति वाली ध्वनि तरंगों का उपयोग करते हैं जब यह तरंगे किसी वस्तु से टकराती है तो वह वापस लौट आती है और सेंसर इसे मापता है यह जानकारी उपयोगकर्ता को विभिन्न प्रकार से दी जा सकती है जैसे वाइब्रेशन , ध्वनि संकेत या दोनों के संयोजन के माध्यम से ।
Solution: अंधे लोगों के लिए चश्मा बनाने में अल्ट्रासोनिक सेंसर का उपयोग एक उन्नत समाधान हो सकता है । यह चश्मा अल्ट्रासोनिक और इन्फ्रारेड तकनीकों का मिश्रण कर सकता है जिससे उपयोगकर्ता को आस - पास की वस्तुओं की जानकारी मिल सके । अल्ट्रासोनिक सेंसर से उपयोगकर्ता को आवाज या वाइब्रेशन के माध्यम से सूचित करती है । यह चश्मा अंधे लोगों के लिए बेहद फायदेमंद हो सकती है , क्योंकि इससे उन्हें आस - पास के अवरोधों जैसे दीवारों , स्टूल , टेबल्स या चलती गाड़ियों से अवगत कराता है । इसके अलावा यह उन्हें सड़कों पर चलने गंतव्य तक पहुंचाने और रास्ते में आने वाली बाधाओ से बचने में मदद करती है।
problem_translated: The development of spectacles for visually impaired individuals is a significant technological step, in which ultrasonic sensors are being used. These spectacles help them accurately assess objects in their surroundings, especially in situations where vision is lacking. With the help of ultrasonic sensors, these spectacles understand the environment using sound waves and inform the user in real-time about the position and distance of objects. Ultrasonic sensors use high-frequency sound waves; when these waves strike an object, they return, and the sensor measures them. This information can be conveyed to the user in various ways, such as through vibrations, sound signals, or a combination of both.
solution_translated: The use of ultrasonic sensors in making spectacles for blind people can be an advanced solution. These spectacles can combine ultrasonic and infrared technologies to provide the user with information about nearby objects. The ultrasonic sensor informs the user through sound or vibration. These spectacles can be extremely beneficial for blind people because they make them aware of nearby obstacles such as walls, stools, tables, or moving vehicles. Additionally, they help them walk on roads, reach their destination, and avoid obstacles along the way.
summarization: The problem addresses the challenge faced by visually impaired individuals in navigating their surroundings. The proposed solution is the development of smart spectacles that utilize ultrasonic and infrared sensors to detect nearby objects. These spectacles provide real-time information to the user through vibrations or sound, helping them identify obstacles and safely reach their destinations.

problem_translated: We have often seen around us that in summer, the water in the tank becomes hot, and in winter, the water in the tank becomes cold. There is extreme heat in summer and extreme cold in winter.
solution_translated: By wrapping a jute sack around the water tank and then applying a paste of calcium (hydroxide) lime water and soil over it, the water temperature will neither decrease nor increase, keeping the water temperature in the tank stable.
summarization: The problem addresses the issue of water in tanks becoming excessively hot in summer and too cold in winter. The proposed solution involves wrapping a jute sack around the water tank and applying a paste of lime water and soil to it, which will help maintain a stable water temperature.

Problem: எங்கள் ஊரில் இந்த பிரச்சனை உள்ளது.
Solution:
ஒரு வீடு அல்லது வங்கிகளிள் அதிகமாக திருட்டு நடக்கிறது இதற்கு என்ன தீர்வு ?
  
 ஒரு விட்டில் திருட்டு நடப்பதை காவல்துறைக்கு "sensor" முலமாக தானாகவே தெரிவிக்கும் ஒரு யோசனை ஆகும். 
 ஒரு "laser" முலமாக "LDR"மிது laser படும்படி இருக்கு. அப்படி laserபடவிள்ளை என்றாள் காவல்துறைக்கு அபாய ஒலி கேட்கும். இப்பொளுது திருடன் வீட்டிற்குள் சென்று அந்த laser ldr மிது படாமல் திருடன் மிதுபடும் அதனால் காவல்துறைக்கு அபாய ஒலி கேட்கும். அதன் பின்னர் காவல்துறை அதிகாரிகள் திருடனை பிடித்து செல்வர்.
 வீடுகள் மற்றும் வங்கிகளிலும் அனைத்து இடங்களிளும் இருக்க வேண்டும்.
problem_translated: This problem exists in our village.
solution_translated:
There are many thefts happening in houses or banks. What is the solution for this?

This is an idea to automatically inform the police about a theft happening in a house through a "sensor".

A "laser" will be set up so that it falls on an "LDR" (Light Dependent Resistor). If the laser does not fall on it, an alarm will sound for the police. Now, if a thief enters the house and the laser falls on the thief instead of the LDR, an alarm will sound for the police. After that, police officers will catch the thief.

This should be installed in houses, banks, and all other places.
summarization: The problem identified is frequent thefts in homes and banks. The proposed solution is a laser-based security system where a laser beam continuously falls on an LDR. If a thief breaks the laser beam, an alarm automatically alerts the police, enabling them to apprehend the thief. This system is suggested for installation in homes, banks, and other vulnerable locations.

Problem: உங்களின் பாதுகாப்பு கண்காணிப்பு திறன்கள் மற்றும் சம்பவ பதிலளிப்பு நடைமுறைகளின் செயல்திறனை மதிப்பிட உதவும் அச்சுறுத்தல் நுண்ணறிவு-உந்துதல் எதிரி உருவகப்படுத்துதல்

Problem: ഏഴാം തരത്തിലെ ശാസ്ത്ര പുസ്തകത്തിലെ ഒന്നാമത്തെ യൂണിറ്റായ വിളയിക്കാം നൂറുമേനി എന്ന പാഠഭാഗത്തിലെ കാർഷീക വിളകൾ എങ്ങനെ മെച്ചപ്പെടുത്താം എന്ന ചർച്ചയിലാണ് ഇത്തരമൊരു പ്രൊജക്ട് ചെയ്യാനുള്ള പ്രേരണയായത്.കാവുകളിൽ മരങ്ങൾ വളങ്ങളൊന്നും ചേർക്കാതെ തന്നെ നല്ല രീതിയിൽ വളരുന്നു. നമ്മുടെ വീടുകളിലും മരങ്ങൾ വളർത്തിയാൽ കൂടുതൽ ഫലം കിട്ടും . കാവുകളുടെ തനത് സ്വഭാവം തൊടിയിലുള്ള സസ്യജാലങ്ങളിൽ പ്രയോഗിച്ചാൽ ആരോഗ്യമുള്ള ചെടികൾ വളർത്തിയെടുത്ത് മെച്ചപ്പെട്ട വിളകൾ വർധിപ്പിക്കാം.തെങ്ങ് മുതലായ സസ്യങ്ങൾക്ക് തടമെടുത്ത് വളം ചേർക്കുമ്പോൾ അവയുടെ വേരുകൾക്ക് ക്ഷതമേൽക്കുന്നു . അതിനാൽ അ വളപ്രയോഗം സസ്യങ്ങൾക്ക് മുഴുവനും ലഭിക്കുന്നില്ല . അതുകൊണ്ട് വിളവ് കുറയുന്നു. കാവുകളിൽ വേരുകൾ മുറിച്ചു കൊണ്ടുള്ള വളപ്രയോഗം നടക്കുന്നില്ല . അങ്ങനെ ചെയ്താൽ നാട്ടിൻ പുറങ്ങളിലെ സസ്യങ്ങളിൽ നല്ല രീതിയിൽ ഉൽപാദനം ഉണ്ടാക്കാൻ കഴിയും .
Solution: കാവുകളെപ്പോലെ നാട്ടിൻ പുറങ്ങളിലെ വൃക്ഷങ്ങളിൽ പുതയിടൽ സമ്പ്രദായം നടപ്പിലാക്കിയാൽ കൂടുതൽ വിളവ് ലഭിക്കും . ജാപ്പാനീസ് മാതൃകയായ ' മിയോ വാക്കി ' വനവൽക്കരണ പദ്ധതി പ്രകാരം ചുരുങ്ങിയ സ്ഥലത്ത് വനവൽക്കരണ പദ്ധതി നടപ്പിലാക്കാം.മണ്ണിന്റെ ഈർപ്പം സംരക്ഷിക്കാൻ മണ്ണിൻറെ ഫലഭൂയിഷ്ഠ തയും ആരോഗ്യവും മെച്ചപ്പെടുത്തൽ കളകളുടെ വളർച്ച കുറയ്ക്കൽ എന്നിവ പുതിയത് കൊണ്ടുള്ള പ്രയോജനമാണെന്ന് കൃഷി ഓഫീസറിൽ നിന്നും അഭിമുഖത്തിലൂടെ മനസ്സിലാക്കാൻ സാധിച്ചു. കാവ് സംരക്ഷണം , വനസംരക്ഷണം എന്നിവയുടെ പ്രാധാന്യം ജനങ്ങളിലേക്ക് എത്തിക്കാൻ ബോധവൽക്കരണ ക്ലാസുകൾ സംഘടിപ്പിച്ചു.
problem_translated: The inspiration for this project came from the discussion on 'How to improve agricultural crops' in the first unit, 'Let's Grow a Hundredfold,' of the 7th-grade science textbook. In sacred groves (Kavu), trees grow well without adding any fertilizers. If we grow trees in our homes too, we will get more yield. If the unique characteristics of sacred groves are applied to the plants in our yards, we can grow healthy plants and increase improved yields. When we dig around plants like coconut trees and add fertilizer, their roots get damaged. Therefore, the fertilizer application does not fully reach the plants. Because of this, the yield decreases. In sacred groves, fertilizer application by cutting roots does not happen. If this is done, good production can be achieved in plants in rural areas.
solution_translated: If the mulching system is implemented for trees in rural areas, similar to sacred groves, more yield will be obtained. According to the Japanese model 'Miyawaki' afforestation project, afforestation can be implemented in a small area. Through an interview with the agricultural officer, it was understood that the benefits of mulching include conserving soil moisture, improving soil fertility and health, and reducing weed growth. Awareness classes were organized to convey the importance of sacred grove conservation and forest conservation to the public.
summarization: The problem highlights that traditional fertilization methods damage plant roots, leading to reduced crop yields, unlike sacred groves (Kavu) where trees thrive naturally without such interventions. The proposed solution is to implement mulching practices for trees in rural areas, inspired by sacred groves, to increase yields. Additionally, the student suggests using the Miyawaki method for afforestation and organizing awareness campaigns on conservation.

Problem: ഭൂകീഴ്പ്പുകൾ (Landslides) പ്രകൃതി ദുരന്തങ്ങളിൽ ഒരേതാണ്, ഇത് മനുഷ്യജീവിതത്തിന്, പ്രാപർട്ടിക്ക് വലിയ തകർച്ചകൾ ഉണ്ടാക്കുന്നു. ഇത്തരം ദുരന്തങ്ങൾ മുൻകൂട്ടി പ്രവചിക്കാൻ വളരെ പ്രയാസമാണ്. എന്നാൽ, അർദ്വിനോ (Arduino UNO) ഉപയോഗിച്ച് സെൻസറുകൾ, പ്രത്യേകിച്ച് വൈബ്രേഷൻ സെൻസർ (vibration sensor) മണ്ണിന്റെ ജലാംശം (soil moisture) സെൻസർ, ഉപയോഗിച്ച് ഭൂകീഴ്പ്പ് സാധ്യതകൾ തിരിച്ചറിയാനും GSM മൊഡ്യൂൾ വഴി SMS മുന്നറിയിപ്പ് അയയ്ക്കാനും ഒരു സംവിധാനത്തിന്റെ രൂപകൽപ്പന ചെയ്യുന്നത് ഈ പദ്ധതിയുടെ ലക്ഷ്യമാണ്. ഇത് ഭൂകീഴ്പ്പുകൾക്ക് മുമ്പ് മുന്നറിയിപ്പ് നൽകാൻ സഹായകമായിരിക്കും, ഒപ്പം പ്രാദേശിക എമർജൻസി പ്രാധാന്യങ്ങൾക്കും ഉയർന്ന സുരക്ഷയും ലഭ്യമാക്കും.
Solution:
ഞങ്ങളുടെ കണ്ടെത്തിയ പരിഹാരം Arduino UNO അടിസ്ഥാനമാക്കി ഒരു ഭൂകീഴ്പ്പ് മുന്നറിയിപ്പ് സിസ്റ്റം ആണ്. ഇത് GSM മൊഡ്യൂൾ, വൈബ്രേഷൻ സെൻസർ, മണ്ണിന്റെ ജലശേഷി സെൻസർ എന്നിവ ഉപയോഗിച്ച് പ്രവർത്തിക്കുന്നു.
 പ്രവർത്തന രീതി:
 വൈബ്രേഷൻ സെൻസർ ഭൂകീഴ്പ്പുകളുടെ അടയാളങ്ങൾ കണ്ടെത്തുന്നു, Arduino UNO ഇക്കാര്യങ്ങൾ പ്രോസസ്സ് ചെയ്ത്.

problem_translated: Landslides are one of the natural disasters that cause great damage to human life and property. Such disasters are very difficult to predict in advance. However, the aim of this project is to design a system that can identify the possibility of landslides using sensors, especially a vibration sensor and a soil moisture sensor, with Arduino UNO, and send SMS warnings via a GSM module. This will be helpful in providing warnings before landslides, and will also provide higher safety for local emergency services.
solution_translated: Our proposed solution is an Arduino UNO-based landslide warning system. It works using a GSM module, a vibration sensor, and a soil moisture sensor. How it works: The vibration sensor detects signs of landslides, and Arduino UNO processes this information. The Soil Moisture Sensor detects soil moisture, and an SMS is sent via the GSM module. Who it helps: Local communities: If the possibility of landslides is known in advance, people can move to safe places. Emergency services: Rescuers receive real-time messages, enabling them to take quick action. Benefits of the solution: Early detection of landslides and prevention of losses. Safety for local communities and quick operational capability for emergency services.
summarization: Landslides are devastating natural disasters that are hard to predict. This project proposes an Arduino UNO-based system to detect potential landslides using vibration and soil moisture sensors. It aims to send SMS warnings via a GSM module, providing early alerts to local communities and emergency services to enhance safety and prevent losses.

problem_translated: A new model is needed for organic waste management in schools. The methods currently being used are not fully effective. There are problems with worms and rats.
solution_translated: Set up a kitchen garden. In the garden, prepare four or five pits of 30cm x 30cm x 30cm between the saplings. Deposit each day's organic waste in a net box raised above ground level in the garden. The next day, deposit it in a pit and cover it with 2cm thick soil. When one pit is full, use the next pit. Once all pits are full, use the organic fertilizer from the first pit for the plants. Repeat.
summarization: The problem addresses the need for a new and effective organic waste management model in schools, as current methods are ineffective and lead to issues like worms and rats. The proposed solution involves setting up a kitchen garden with multiple pits. Daily organic waste is collected in a net box, then buried in a pit and covered with soil, creating a rotating composting system. The resulting organic fertilizer is then used for the garden plants.

Problem:
The "Bus Safety System: Protecting Kids & Pedestrians" is an innovative solution designed to enhance safety around buses, particularly for children and other pedestrians who might be at risk when a bus is stationary. This system addresses a critical safety issue: when a bus is stopped, children or pedestrians may walk in front of the bus, potentially putting themselves in danger if the driver cannot see them. Our system utilizes simple yet effective technology to prevent such accidents and ensure a safer environment.
 Problem Statement
 When a bus stops, especially in areas where visibility is limited, children might walk in front of the bus without the driver's knowledge. This can lead to dangerous situations where the bus might accidentally move forward, potentially causing accidents. To address this problem, a reliable and responsive safety system is needed to alert both the driver and the pedestrians.
Solution: Our solution is the "Bus Safety System: Protecting Kids & Pedestrians," which aims to enhance safety around stationary buses. It uses IR sensors mounted at the front of the bus to detect the presence of pedestrians. When a pedestrian is detected, the system activates a buzzer and a red visual light to alert the driver. Simultaneously, a playback module announces a pre-recorded message, "Please move away from the front of the bus," to notify pedestrians. Additionally, the system integrates with the bus’s control to prevent movement if a pedestrian is detected. This solution helps children, pedestrians, and drivers by providing clear, immediate alerts and preventing accidents. It ensures that pedestrians are aware of their proximity to the bus and prevents the bus from moving until the area is clear, thereby addressing visibility issues and enhancing overall safety.

Problem:
Hydroponic farming can face a number of challenges, including: 
 High setup cost: Setting up a hydroponic system can be expensive, especially for large-scale systems. 
 Constant power supply: Hydroponic systems need electricity to run continuously. 
 Maintenance and monitoring: Growers need to be vigilant to avoid component failure. 
 Common problems: Some common problems include wilting, dead roots, system clogging, infestation, and nutrient deficiencies
Solution:
Problem: Wilting
 
 It can be due to several factors such as less irrigation or high temperature, where the plant loses its rigidity, and leaves start drying.in our project automatic mobile controlled drip irrigation is used.this is managed from our house and controled thousands of hydroponic plants in one time .
 
  
 
 Solution: You should let your roots dry between each irrigation cycle. A backup pump should always be handy if the operating one gets fail because the plants can wilt quickly without water supply.
 
  
 
 Problem: Dead Roots
 
 There are many reasons for dead roots like high temperature of water, very high or very low EC, overwatering in dense substrates, and others. Dead roots can also be a sign of root rot pathogen infecting the system.

problem_translated: Our school is facing drinking water scarcity since long. Tap water is not available in the school. Our school manages water by buckets or by tankers. The village in which the school is located has been divided into three habitations or Mohlas: Dodder Mohala, Khoja Mohlas, and Raja Mohlas. The school is located in Raja Mohla, which is situated on a high altitude as compared to the other two habitations or Mohlas. Two habitations among the three receive frequent supply of tap water, but the school habitation couldn't receive enough water to fulfill the demand of water in the school. Due to this problem, the inhabitants of the school habitation and the school itself suffer a lot.
solution_translated: The village has about 10 natural water springs excreting pure crystal clear water continuously. The water flows 24×7 and gets wasted due to mismanagement. If that water is collected in a well-constructed water bowl at the spring site, then lifted through a water pump and supplied to the school and inhabitants of the school habitation, the water crisis in the school and school habitation will resolve forever in the area.
summarization: The school and its surrounding high-altitude habitation suffer from a long-standing drinking water scarcity, as they do not receive adequate tap water supply. The proposed solution is to utilize the village's numerous natural springs, which currently waste water continuously. By collecting this spring water in a well, pumping it, and supplying it to the school and the habitation, the water crisis can be permanently resolved.

problem_translated: I recently went on a Manali tour with my family for a week. Most of our journey on this tour was by train. During the journey, I noticed that the train toilet was right near our reserved seat, and a foul smell was coming from it. When I went to the bathroom, I saw that the toilet was very dirty. People would use the toilet and come out without flushing (using water), which caused the bad smell to spread not only in the toilet but also in the nearby coach.
solution_translated: Our team found an easy way to solve this problem. We managed the toilet flush and the toilet door in such a way that if a person leaves without flushing the toilet, as soon as they open the door, the flush will automatically turn on. A few seconds after the flush is complete, the door will lock again. This will make it convenient for all train passengers to use the toilet.
summarization: The problem identified is the unhygienic condition of train toilets due to passengers not flushing, leading to foul smells spreading to nearby seats. The proposed solution is an automatic system where if a user leaves the toilet without flushing, the flush will activate automatically when the door is opened, and the door will re-lock after flushing is complete. This aims to ensure cleanliness and convenience for all passengers.

problem_translated: Our problem is that many times, the gas cylinder runs out in people's homes, and at that time, it becomes difficult to get one from another house. This is what our problem is about.
solution_translated: We have addressed this problem very well. Our team has installed a meter on top of the cylinder. That meter will show how much gas is remaining inside the cylinder. problem_translated: Many people in the city cross traffic signals without waiting for the signal, which increases the risk of accidents. For this, we have created a smart traffic system which allows only one signal to pass, after which the other signals close. This greatly reduces the possibility of accidents.
solution_translated: In the smart traffic system, if the signal is for one side, it automatically closes all other paths with gates. This prevents any vehicle driver from crossing the road without the signal, which can greatly reduce accidents at signals. Because vehicles can only go from one side, the chances of them colliding will be greatly reduced, and accidents on the road can be minimized. This will significantly reduce human casualties. This is very beneficial for people, especially for vehicle drivers. This is an idea for our project, which we have built as a prototype. It significantly reduces traffic-related accidents. This is the smart traffic system.
summarization: The problem addresses the high risk of accidents caused by people crossing traffic signals without waiting for their turn. The proposed solution is a smart traffic system that uses automatic gates to ensure only one path is open at a time, preventing unauthorized crossings. This system aims to significantly reduce collisions and human casualties by streamlining traffic flow and enforcing signal compliance.

Problem:
औद्योगिक कार्यशालाओं में, आरा मशीनों का उपयोग आम तौर पर सामग्री काटने के लिए किया जाता है। हालाँकि, ये मशीनें ऑपरेटरों के लिए महत्वपूर्ण सुरक्षा जोखिम पैदा करती हैं, जिसमें आकस्मिक हाथ की चोट एक बड़ी चिंता का विषय है। आपातकालीन स्टॉप बटन या सुरक्षात्मक गार्ड जैसे पारंपरिक सुरक्षा तंत्र दुर्घटनाओं को रोकने के लिए पर्याप्त तेज़ी से प्रतिक्रिया नहीं कर सकते हैं।

problem_translated: In industrial workshops, saw machines are commonly used for cutting materials. However, these machines pose significant safety risks for operators, with accidental hand injuries being a major concern. Traditional safety mechanisms like emergency stop buttons or protective guards may not react quickly enough to prevent accidents. The aim of this project is to design and implement a *real-time safety system* using an *ultrasonic sensor* and *Arduino*. If an object (such as the operator's hand) comes within **30 cm** of the saw blade, the system will automatically stop the saw machine, preventing potential injuries. Additionally, a *manual emergency stop button* will be integrated for extra safety. The motor will only resume operation when the object moves beyond the specified safety distance. 1. Prevent accidents by stopping the saw motor if an object or hand is detected within 30 cm of the blade.
solution_translated:
Our solution is an *automatic safety system* that stops the saw motor if an object or hand comes within *30 cm* of the blade. This system is built using an *ultrasonic sensor (HC-SR04)*, an *Arduino UNO*, and a *relay module* that controls a 5V DC motor simulating the saw blade. Additionally, an *emergency stop button* provides manual control for immediate shutdown.
### *How the solution works:*
1. *Object Detection:*
- If the operator's hand comes within *30 cm*, the waves bounce back, and Arduino calculates that if the distance is less than *30 cm*, Arduino triggers the **relay module** to *turn off* the motor.
2. *Automatic Motor Control:*
- If no hand is detected within 30 cm, the motor runs normally.

summarization: The project addresses the high risk of hand injuries from saw machines in industrial workshops, where traditional safety measures are often too slow. The proposed solution is a real-time safety system that uses an ultrasonic sensor and an Arduino to automatically stop the saw motor if an object or hand comes within 30 cm of the blade. This system, which also includes a manual emergency stop, aims to prevent accidents and enhance overall safety for operators.

Problem: यदि कही किसी दुर्घटना से आग लग जाय और यदि इसका सही समय में समाधान न किया जाय तो यह भयंकर रूप धारण कर लेती है। यदि किसी जगह पर आग लग जाती है और हमे उसका पता नही है तो यह धीरे धीरे विशाल रूप धारण कर लेता है जहा आग लगा है उसके साथ आस पास का पूरा क्षेत्र बर्बाद हो जाता है।
Solution:
हमने इस समस्या के समाधान के लिए एक स्मार्ट डिवाइस जिसका नाम है फायर अलर्ट सिस्टम का निर्माण किया है। यह स्मार्ट उपकरण है यह जिस नंबर से कनेक्ट है उसे नंबर पर आग लग जाने पर मैसेज और कॉल करता है जिससे हमें पता चल जाता है आग लगी है और हम फायर ब्रिगेड के पास कॉल कर सकते हैं और इसे होने वाले भयंकर परिणाम को रोक सकते हैं।
 यह फायर या स्मोक को डिटेक्ट करता है उसके बाद अलर्ट सिग्नल भेजता है। हम दुनिया के किसी भी कोने पर होंगे हमे इसका मैसेज,कॉल प्राप्त होगा।
problem_translated: If a fire breaks out somewhere due to an accident and if it is not addressed in time, it takes on a terrible form. If a fire starts in a place and we are unaware of it, it gradually grows huge, destroying the entire surrounding area along with the place where the fire started.
solution_translated: To solve this problem, we have created a smart device called the Fire Alert System. This is a smart device. When a fire breaks out, it sends a message and makes a call to the number it is connected to, which informs us about the fire, and we can call the fire brigade and prevent its terrible consequences. It detects fire or smoke and then sends an alert signal. Wherever we are in the world, we will receive its message and call.
summarization: The problem addresses the severe destruction caused by fires that go unnoticed or are not addressed in time. The proposed solution is a "Fire Alert System" smart device that detects fire or smoke and immediately sends messages and calls to a connected number, enabling prompt action by calling the fire brigade and preventing widespread damage, regardless of the user's location.

Problem: भूकंप एक प्राकृतिक आपदा है जो किसी भी समय और किसी भी स्थान पर आ सकती है।
Solution: भूकंप अलार्म भूकंप आने के समय बजने लगता है जिससे समय रहते लोग घरों से लोग सुरक्षित स्थान पर जा सकते हैं।
problem_translated: An earthquake is a natural disaster that can occur at any time and in any place.
solution_translated: The earthquake alarm starts ringing when an earthquake occurs, allowing people to move from their homes to a safe place in time.
summarization: The problem addresses earthquakes as unpredictable natural disasters. The proposed solution is an earthquake alarm that activates during an earthquake, providing people with timely warning to evacuate their homes and move to a safe location.

Problem: हमारे गांव में एक महिला अपने किचन में गैस में दूध चढ़ा कर चली चली गई थी तो हवा के कारण गैस के बजने से पूरे किचन में एलपीजी गैस फैल जाता है । फिर वह महिला वापस किचन में आती है तो उसने देखा कि गैस बुझ चुका था फिर उसने गैस जलाने के लिए लाइटर में क्लिक किया फिर वहां ब्लास्ट हुआ जिससे उस महिला के साथ दुर्घटना हो गई ।
Solution: यह गैस सेफ्टी डिवाइस गैस के रिसाव को सेंस करके रेगुलेटर को ऑफ करेगा और एक बजर बजेगा । जिससे अगर कोई व्यक्ति आसपास हो तो उसे पता चल जाएगा कि यहां गैस रिसाव हुआ है। जिससे दुर्घटना होने के संभावना कम हो जाएगी । यह किचन में काम करने वाले महिलाओं , वर्कर सभी के लिए उपयोगी है ।
problem_translated: In our village, a woman had put milk on the gas stove in her kitchen and left. Due to the wind, the gas flame went out, and LPG gas spread throughout the kitchen. When the woman returned to the kitchen, she saw that the gas flame was out. Then she clicked the lighter to light the gas, and there was a blast, which caused an accident with that woman.
solution_translated: This gas safety device will sense gas leakage, turn off the regulator, and a buzzer will sound. This way, if someone is nearby, they will know that there has been a gas leakage. This will reduce the possibility of accidents. It is useful for women working in the kitchen, workers, and everyone.
summarization: The problem highlights a dangerous situation where a gas flame extinguishes due to wind, causing gas to accumulate and leading to an explosion when someone attempts to relight it. The proposed solution is a gas safety device that detects leaks, automatically shuts off the gas regulator, and activates a buzzer to alert people, thereby preventing accidents.

Problem: "टच इलेक्ट्रिक बोर्ड" एक प्रकार का इंटरएक्टिव बोर्ड है, जिसका उपयोग शिक्षा, कार्यस्थल, और अन्य इंटरएक्टिव उद्देश्यों के लिए किया जाता है। यह आमतौर पर एक डिजिटल डिस्प्ले के रूप में होता है, जिसे टचस्क्रीन तकनीक के माध्यम से नियंत्रित किया जा सकता है। इसमें किसी भी प्रकार के कंटेंट (जैसे कि टेक्स्ट, इमेज, वीडियो आदि) को प्रदर्शित किया जा सकता है और उसे टच स्क्रीन से इंटरैक्ट करके उपयोग किया जा सकता है। यह खासकर क्लासरूम, मीटिंग रूम, और कॉन्फ्रेंस में काम आता है।
Solution:
TOUCH ELECTRIC BOARD एक इंटरेक्टिव और स्मार्ट तकनीक है जो विद्युत उपकरणों के संचालन को टच स्क्रीन के माध्यम से नियंत्रित करने की सुविधा प्रदान करती है। इसका उद्देश्य पारंपरिक स्विच और कंट्रोल सिस्टम की जगह एक अधिक उन्नत, यूजर-फ्रेंडली, और स्मार्ट समाधान देना है। इलेक्ट्रिक बोर्ड में एक डिजिटल टच स्क्रीन होती है, जो उपयोगकर्ता को सीधे स्क्रीन पर टच करने के माध्यम से विभिन्न विद्युत उपकरणों को नियंत्रित करने की सुविधा देती है।विद्युत सर्किट से जुड़ी जानकारी को प्रोसेस करके सही आदेश भेजते हैं। जैसे ही आप स्क्रीन पर किसी बटन को टैप करते हैं, यह सिग्नल विद्युत सर्किट को मिलता है और संबंधित उपकरण सक्रिय या निष्क्रिय हो जाता है, मदद करता है-घरों में,ऑफिस और इंडस्ट्रियल सेटिंग्स में,विशेष आवश्यकताओं वाले व्यक्तियों के लिए,
 यह समस्या को सुलझाएगा-1कम्फर्ट और कंवीनियंस- किसी भी स्विच को ढूंढ़ने या हाथ से चलाने की जरूरत नहीं, बस टच करें और उपकरण चालू हो जाएगा। 2.स्मार्ट एनर्जी मैनेजमें3.रिमोट कंट्रोल 4.एक्सेसिबिलिटी
 इस तरह से एक स्मार्ट, सुविधाजनक, और ऊर्जा की बचत करनेकरने वाला समाधान है
problem_translated: "Touch Electric Board" is a type of interactive board, which is used for education, workplaces, and other interactive purposes. It is usually in the form of a digital display, which can be controlled through touchscreen technology. Any type of content (such as text, images, videos, etc.) can be displayed on it and used by interacting with the touch screen. It is especially useful in classrooms, meeting rooms, and conferences.
solution_translated: TOUCH ELECTRIC BOARD is an interactive and smart technology that provides the facility to control the operation of electrical appliances through a touch screen. Its aim is to provide a more advanced, user-friendly, and smart solution instead of traditional switches and control systems. The electric board has a digital touch screen, which allows the user to control various electrical appliances by directly touching the screen. It processes information related to the electrical circuit and sends the correct commands. As soon as you tap a button on the screen, this signal is received by the electrical circuit and the corresponding appliance becomes active or inactive. It helps in homes, offices and industrial settings, and for individuals with special needs. This will solve the problem of: 1. Comfort and Convenience - No need to search for any switch or operate it manually, just touch and the appliance will turn on. 2. Smart Energy Management. 3. Remote Control. 4. Accessibility. In this way, it is a smart, convenient, and energy-saving solution.
summarization: The problem identifies the need for an interactive digital display, called a "Touch Electric Board," for educational, workplace, and conference settings, where content can be controlled via a touchscreen. The proposed solution is a "TOUCH ELECTRIC BOARD" that replaces traditional switches with a digital touchscreen to control electrical appliances. This smart technology offers comfort, convenience, smart energy management, remote control, and improved accessibility in various environments.

Problem: दिन प्रतिदिन जनसंख्या बढ़ने के कारण यातायात के साधनों में अत्यधिक वृद्धि हुई है जिस कारण यातायात साधनों में पेट्रोल एवं डीजल का अत्यधिक प्रयोग बढ़ता ही जा रहा है इनसे निकलने वाली गैसों के कारण वायु प्रदूषण बढ़ता ही जा रहा है आज के समय में एक ऐसे आदर्श ईंधन की आवश्यकता है जो कम से कम प्रदूषण उत्पन्न करें वहां से निकलने वाले ब्लैक तेल से ऐसे ही एक आदर्श ईंधन का निर्माण किया जा सकता है ब्लैक ऑयल के जलने पर नीले रंग के धुएं के रूप में मिथुन गैस निकलती है मेथेन एक महत्वपूर्ण गैस है जिसका उपयोग ईंधन के रूप में किया जा सकता है मीथेन गैस का उपयोग विभिन्न क्षेत्रों में किया जा सकता है जैसे ऊर्जा उत्पादन रसोई गैस औद्योगिक उपयोग वाहन चालन कृषि चिकित्सा वैज्ञानिक अनुसंधान आदि
Solution: ब्लैक ऑयल जो लोग वेस्ट समझ कर फेंक देते हैं उसका आदर्श ईंधन के रूप में उपयोग किया जा सकता है एवं जिसका ज्वलन ताप भी उच्च होता है इस ब्लैक तेल में मीथेन गैस प्रेजेंट रहती है जो एक आदर्श ईंधन के रूप में काम करती हैइसका उपयोग घर से लेकर उद्योगों तक चिकित्सा क्षेत्र अनुसंधान क्षेत्र वहां हर क्षेत्र में किया जा सकता है क्योंकि यह एक आदर्श ईंधन है इसलिए इसका उपयोग व्यापक स्तर पर किया जा सकता है यह हर तरीके से उत्तम ईंधन होता है
problem_translated: Due to the increasing population day by day, there has been a significant increase in means of transport, which has led to a continuous rise in the excessive use of petrol and diesel in vehicles. Air pollution is constantly increasing due to the gases emitted from these. In today's time, there is a need for an ideal fuel that produces minimum pollution. Such an ideal fuel can be produced from the black oil that is generated. When black oil burns, methane gas is released in the form of blue smoke. Methane is an important gas that can be used as fuel. Methane gas can be used in various fields such as energy production, cooking gas, industrial use, vehicle propulsion, agriculture, medicine, scientific research, etc.
solution_translated: Black oil, which people throw away considering it waste, can be used as an ideal fuel, and its ignition temperature is also high. Methane gas is present in this black oil, which acts as an ideal fuel. It can be used from homes to industries, in the medical field, research field, and every other field. Since it is an ideal fuel, it can be used on a wide scale. It is an excellent fuel in every way.
summarization: The problem addresses the rising air pollution caused by the increasing use of petrol and diesel in transport due to population growth, highlighting the need for a less polluting, ideal fuel. The proposed solution is to utilize waste black oil, which contains methane gas, as this ideal fuel. This methane-rich black oil can be burned to release methane gas, offering a cleaner energy source for various applications from homes to industries, and contributing to reduced pollution.

Problem: हमारे आसपास कचरे की समस्या बहुत होती है और कचरा सड़कों पर बिखरा होता है जिससे मलेरिया जैसी बीमारियां फैलती है
Solution: हम यह एक डस्टबिन की तरह ही है इसमें कचरा डालेंगे और वह डंडा डूबेगा और जिससे एक सिक्का बाहर निकलेगा और उसे सिक्के को लोग देखकर उसमें ज्यादा कचरा डालेंगे और जिस गांव क्लीन होगा और कचरा एकत्रित करने में सहायता मिलेगी इसलिए यह दो-तीन ऐसे ही गांव में लगा देंगे जिससे सभी लोग डालेंगे और कचरा करते तो होगा जिससे बीमारियां न मिलेगी यह कचरा विकिरण करने वाले लोगों को देंगे जिससे यह नई चीज बनाएंगे जिससे लोगों को काम आएगी
problem_translated: There is a big problem of waste around us, and garbage is scattered on the roads, which spreads diseases like malaria.
solution_translated: This is like a dustbin. We will put garbage in it, and a stick will sink, from which a coin will come out. Seeing that coin, people will be encouraged to put more garbage in it. This will help keep the village clean and collect waste. We will install two or three such devices in the village so that everyone puts in garbage and waste is collected, preventing the spread of diseases. This collected waste will be given to waste processing people, who will make new things from it that will be useful to people.
summarization: The problem addresses the issue of scattered garbage on roads, which leads to the spread of diseases like malaria. The proposed solution is an incentivized dustbin that rewards users with a coin for depositing waste. This encourages more people to use it, helping to keep the village clean and collect waste, which can then be given for processing to create new useful products.

Problem:
कामकाजी महिलाओं को घर की साफ सफाई में, पोछा लगाने में बहुत समय लगता है साथ ही आजकल के खान पान की वजह से और अन्य कारणों से भी महिलाओं को जोड़ों के दर्द आदि से परेशानी का सामना करना पड़ता है।
 घर की साफ सफाई में दिक्कत आती है।
Solution:
हमने घरेलू और कामकाजी महिलाओं की साफ सफाई की परेशानी को देखते हुए एक एसी मशीन बनाई है। जिससे महिलाओं को साफ़ सफ़ाई में समय की बचत होगी।
 साथ ही जीनको जोड़ो में दर्द है वो भी इसका उपयोग एक जगह बैठकर कर सकती हैं।
 इसके पोछा मारने के लिए बार बार पानी बदलने की जरूरत नही होती।
 इस मशीन में हमने पानी डालने का डिब्बा बना दिया है, और नीचे की तरफ पोछे का कपड़ा, साथ ही गंदे पानी को बाहर निकालने की व्यवस्था की है।
 
 साफ पानी एक अलग डिब्बे में डाला और एक डिब्बे में गंदा पानी निकलता रहेगा।
 साफ़ पानी पोछा लगे हुए डिब्बे में जाता रहेगा। और जब पोछा गंदा हो जाएगा तो उसको एक डिब्बे में निचोड़ लेगे जिससे पानी गंदा पानी एकत्रित करने वाले डिब्बे में इकट्ठा हो जाएगा। 
 यह मशीन रिमोट से चलेगी, जिसको एक जगह बैठकर चलाया जा सकेगा।
 इस प्रकार महिलाएं इस रिमोट की सहायता से एक जगह बैठकर पूछा लगा सकेगी।
 इसमें एक बार पानी डालना पड़ता है और मशीन को एक जगह रख कार कंट्रोल कर सकते हैं।
 इस प्रकार महिलाएं एक बार पानी डालकर एक रूम कर जगह बैठकर आराम से साफ सफाई कर सकती हैं।
 तथा अपने समय को भी बचा सकती हैं।
problem_translated: Working women spend a lot of time cleaning and mopping their homes. Additionally, due to modern eating habits and other reasons, women often suffer from problems like joint pain. This makes house cleaning difficult for them.
solution_translated: Considering the cleaning difficulties faced by housewives and working women, we have created a machine. This machine will save women time in cleaning. Also, those with joint pain can use it while sitting in one place. There is no need to change water repeatedly for mopping with this machine. In this machine, we have made a compartment for filling clean water and a mop cloth at the bottom, along with a system to remove dirty water. Clean water is put into one separate compartment, and dirty water will keep coming out into another compartment. Clean water will continuously go into the mopping compartment. When the mop gets dirty, it will be squeezed into a compartment, so the dirty water will collect in the dirty water collection compartment. This machine will run with a remote, which can be operated while sitting in one place. In this way, women will be able to mop while sitting in one place with the help of this remote. Water needs to be filled only once, and the machine can be controlled by keeping it in one place. Thus, women can comfortably clean a room by filling water once and sitting in one place, and they can also save their time.
summarization: The problem addresses the significant time working women spend on house cleaning and mopping, often exacerbated by joint pain. The proposed solution is a remote-controlled mopping machine designed to save time and allow women, especially those with joint pain, to clean while sitting. It features separate compartments for clean and dirty water, eliminating the need for frequent water changes and enabling efficient cleaning of a room with a single water fill.

Problem: विद्यालय में छुट्टियों में पेड़ पौधों का पानी की कमी से मुर्झा जाना तथा कभी तो पौधे पूरी तरह ही खतम हो जाते सुख कर।
Solution:
हमने विद्यालय में लगे पेड़ पौधों की अच्छी वृद्धि के लिए ऐसी तकनीक विकसित की है, जिससे पौधों की अच्छी वृद्धि होगी उनको पानी की समस्या से जूझना नहीं पड़ेगा।
 विद्यालय में लगे सभी छोटे पौधों और बड़ी पेड़ों को एक पाईप लाईन के माध्यम से विद्यालय में बनी टंकी या टांका जिसमे नल लगा हुआ है से जोड़ देगे। 
 नल से एक पाईप बड़ी लंबी पाईप लगाएंगे अब इस मुख्य पाईप से छोटी छोटी पाईप निकालेगे और प्रत्यक छोटी पाईप को विद्यालय में लगे पेड़ पौधों से जोड़ देंगे।
 अब नल में टूटी लगाएंगे ताकि टंकी का पानी उसमें आ सके।
 अब जब भी विद्यालय की लंबी छुट्टी होगी तो हम टूटी को धीमी बूंद बूंद पानी आए ऐसे चालू करके छोड़ देंगे।
 जिससे मुख्य पाईप में पानी जाता रहेगा और उसके माध्यम से छोटी पाईप में।
 छोटी पाईप से प्रेत्यक पेड़ और पोधे में जाता रहेगा।
 इस प्रकार छुट्टियों में भी सभी पौधे हरे भरे रहेंगे और उनकी अच्छी वृद्धि होती रहेगी।
 इस प्रकार इस तकनीक से हम पेड़ को सुरक्षित रख सकते हैं।
problem_translated: During school holidays, trees and plants wither due to lack of water, and sometimes they completely dry up and die.
solution_translated: We have developed a technique for the good growth of trees and plants in the school, which will ensure good growth for the plants and they will not have to struggle with water problems. All small plants and large trees in the school will be connected through a pipeline to the tank or reservoir built in the school, which has a tap installed. A long main pipe will be installed from the tap. Now, small pipes will be branched out from this main pipe, and each small pipe will be connected to the trees and plants in the school. A faucet will be installed in the main pipe (or at the tank outlet) so that water from the tank can flow into it. Now, whenever there is a long school holiday, we will turn on the tap (control valve) to allow water to flow slowly, drop by drop, and leave it. This will ensure water keeps flowing into the main pipe and, through it, into the small pipes. From the small pipes, it will keep going to each tree and plant. In this way, all plants will remain green even during holidays, and their good growth will continue. Thus, with this technique, we can keep the trees safe.
summarization: The problem addresses school plants and trees drying up and dying due to lack of water during long holidays. The proposed solution involves setting up a drip irrigation system. All plants will be connected by pipes to a school water tank. During holidays, a tap will be left open to slowly release water, ensuring continuous hydration and healthy growth for all plants.

Problem: సరుగుడు బొప్పాయి వంటి తోటలు వేసుకునే వాళ్ళు నారుని చిన్నచిన్న నల్లటి ప్లాస్టిక్ సంచుల్లో తెచ్చుకుంటారు అలాగే ఇళ్లల్లో కొన్ని రకాల పూల చెట్లు కానివ్వండి పండ్ల చెట్లు కానివ్వండి వేసుకోవాలనుకున్నప్పుడు కూడా వారు ఆ చెట్లని నల్లటి ప్లాస్టిక్ సంచుల్లో ఇవ్వడం అనేది మనం చూస్తుంటాం ఈ సంచులు తర్వాత ఉపయోగపడం రీసైకిలింగ్ చేయలేం అలాగే ఇవి అలాగే గనక పడేస్తే ప్లాస్టిక్ కాలుష్యం కింద భూమిని కలుషితం చేస్తాయి కనుక ఈ ఎక్కువ చెట్లని తెచ్చుకునేటువంటి రైతులు ఎక్కువగా ఈ ప్లాస్టిక్ కవర్లను ఉపయోగించటం అనేది నేను గమనించినటువంటి పెద్ద సమస్య ఇది భూ కాలుష్యానికి సంబంధించిన సమస్య ఇల్లా ఇళ్లల్లోనూ ఇది సమస్యగానే ఉంది తోటల్లోనూ ఇది సమస్యగానే నాకు కనిపించింది కాబట్టి దీని పరిష్కరించాలని చిన్న ప్రయత్నాన్ని చేయడం జరిగింది
Solution: రైతులు పండ్ల చెట్లు, నిమ్మనారు ఇలాంటివన్నీ తెచ్చుకునేటప్పుడు చిన్న చిన్న ప్లాస్టిక్ కవర్లలో వాళ్ళు నారుని తెచ్చుకుంటూ ఉంటారు. అది రీసైక్లింగ్ కి పనికిరాదు కాబట్టి వాళ్ళు ఆ ప్లాస్టిక్ ని బయటే పారేస్తారు. ప్లాస్టిక్ కాబట్టి అది నీటిని భూమిలోకి చేరనివ్వదు, ఆ ప్లాస్టిక్ భూమిలో కరిగిపోకుండా కొన్ని లక్షల సంవత్సరాలు భూమిలోపల ఉండి భూకాలుష్యంగా రూపాంతరం చెందుతుంది. దీని వల్ల మా చుట్టూ ప్రక్కల గ్రామాల ప్రజలు కష్టాలు ఎదుర్కోవాల్సిన పరిస్థితి వస్తుంది. కాబట్టి దానికి పరిష్కారం కనుక్కుందాము అన్న ఆలోచన నాకు వచ్చింది. దీన్ని మా టీచర్ గారు కూడా బాగుంది అన్నారు. నా ఆలోచన ఏంటంటే, గుళ్ళల్లో గాని ఇళ్ళల్లో గాని కావాల్సినన్ని టెంకాయ చిప్పలు దొరుకుతుంటాయి. వాటిల్లోని కొబ్బరిని వినియోగించిన తర్వాత ఆ ఆ కొబ్బరిచిప్పల్లో నారు నాటి మనము వాటిల్ని పెంచుకోవచ్చు. ప్లాస్టిక్ కవర్లను వాడేకన్నా ఈ కొబ్బరిచిప్పల్లో నారు నాటుకొని దాన్ని మొత్తాన్ని మనం భూమిలో నాటుకోవచ్చు లేదా మొక్క భూమిలో నాటేసిన తర్వాత ఆ చిప్పల్ని తిరిగి కొత్త నారు వేయటానికి ఉపయోగించుకోవచ్చు. ఇలా చేయడం వల్ల భూకాలుష్యాన్ని తగ్గించవచ్చు అని నా ఉద్దేశం.
problem_translated: People who set up plantations like casuarina and papaya bring saplings in small black plastic bags. Similarly, when people want to plant certain types of flower plants or fruit plants in their homes, we see them being given these plants in black plastic bags. These bags are not useful later, and they cannot be recycled. If they are just thrown away, they cause plastic pollution and contaminate the soil. Therefore, the extensive use of these plastic covers by farmers who bring many plants is a major problem I have observed. This is a problem related to soil pollution. It is a problem in homes as well as in plantations. Therefore, a small attempt has been made to solve it.
solution_translated: When farmers bring fruit plants, lemon saplings, and similar items, they bring the saplings in small plastic covers. Since they are not suitable for recycling, they throw that plastic outside. Because it is plastic, it does not allow water to reach the soil, and without dissolving, that plastic remains in the soil for millions of years, transforming into soil pollution. Because of this, people in our surrounding villages will face difficulties. So, the idea to find a solution came to me. My teacher also said it was good. My idea is that plenty of coconut shells are available in temples or homes. After using the coconut inside them, we can plant saplings in those coconut shells and grow them. Instead of using plastic covers, we can plant saplings in these coconut shells and plant the whole thing in the soil, or after planting the plant in the soil, the shells can be reused for planting new saplings. My intention is that by doing this, soil pollution can be reduced.
summarization: The problem addresses the widespread use of small black plastic bags for transporting and planting saplings by farmers and homeowners. These bags are non-recyclable and contribute significantly to soil pollution when discarded. The proposed solution suggests using readily available coconut shells as an eco-friendly alternative. Saplings can be grown in these shells, which can then be planted directly into the ground or reused, effectively reducing plastic waste and soil pollution.

Solution: మా బృందం చాలామంది తో మాట్లాడి ఏదైనా పోషకవిలువలు గల పదార్ధాన్ని తయారుచేయాలని ఆలోచన చేసాము ఇందులో భాగంగా పెసలు,సెనగలు, బీన్స్ గింజలు, గోధుమలు, మెంతులు,అవిసె గింజలను మొలకెత్తింది నీడలో బాగా ఆరబెట్టాలి వీటితోపాటు ఉసిరికాయ ముక్కలను కూడా ఆరబెట్టి పూర్తిగా తేమ పోయేందుకు వేడిచేయాలి మిక్సీలో వేసి పౌడర్ చేయాలి దీనిని ప్రతిరోజూ అన్నంలో చెంచాడు పౌడర్, పావు చెంచా ఆవు నెయ్యి ‌కలిపి‌తినవచ్చు అన్నంతో తినలేమంటే కాస్త తేనె లో నానబెట్టి తినవచ్చు ఇది చౌకగా లభించే పౌష్టికాహారం వీటివలన విటమిన్లు A,C,EKమరియూ ఇనుము, పొటాషియం, మెగ్నీషియం లభిస్తాయి రోగనిరోధక శక్తి పెరుగుతుంది
problem_translated: A health supplement powder is essential for everyone.
solution_translated: Our team spoke with many people and decided to create a nutritious food item. As part of this, green gram, chickpeas, beans, wheat, fenugreek, and flax seeds are sprouted and thoroughly dried in the shade. Along with these, dried amla (Indian gooseberry) pieces are also dried and heated to completely remove moisture. All these ingredients are then put into a mixer and made into a powder. This powder can be consumed daily by mixing one spoonful with rice and a quarter spoonful of cow ghee. If it cannot be eaten with rice, it can be soaked in a little honey and consumed. This is an inexpensive nutritious food. It provides vitamins A, C, E, K, and minerals like iron, potassium, and magnesium, thereby increasing immunity.
summarization: The problem identified is the universal need for a health supplement. The proposed solution is to create an inexpensive, nutritious powder from sprouted and dried ingredients like green gram, chickpeas, various seeds, and amla. This powder, rich in vitamins and minerals, can be consumed daily with rice and ghee or honey to boost immunity.

Problem: పూర్వం ప్రజలు పిల్లలు ఒంటికి పసుపు రాసేవారు ఎందుకంటే పసుపు యాంటి బయాటిక్స్ మరియు శరీరానికి దురదలు రాకుండా చేస్తుంది.పసుపు అంటే మనం వాడే ప్యాకెట్ పసుపు కాదు వాళ్ళే పండించిన పసుపు కొమ్ములను బాగా దంచి తయారు చేసిన పసుపును రాసేవారు.కాని ఇప్పుడు బోడీ లోషన్స రాస్తున్నారు మరియు డైపర్స వాడుతున్నారు దీని కారణంగా రాషెస్ వస్తున్నాయి.
Solution: చిన్న పిల్లల ఒంటికి రాషెస్ రాకుండా చేయడం కోసం సహజమైన రసాయనాలు ఉపయోగించి డైపర్స్ ను తయారు చేయడం.
problem_translated: In the past, people used to apply turmeric to children's bodies because turmeric is an antibiotic and prevents body itching. This was not the packaged turmeric we use, but turmeric made by grinding the turmeric roots they grew themselves. However, now body lotions are being applied and diapers are being used, which are causing rashes.
solution_translated: To prevent rashes on young children's bodies, make diapers using natural compounds.
summarization: The problem highlights that modern practices of using body lotions and diapers on children cause rashes, unlike the traditional method of applying home-ground turmeric which prevented skin issues. The proposed solution is to develop diapers using natural compounds to prevent these rashes on young children's bodies.

Solution: ముందుగా మేము ఒక చిన్న వైరు తీసుకున్నాము.గోడలకు రంగును వేసే బ్రష్ ను తీసుకొని దానిని కొంచెం కత్తిరించి వైరును దానిలో పెట్టాము. వైరులో ఉండే జీ వైరును తీసి రెండు భాగాలు చేశాము. ఆ రెండు భాగాలను ఇనుమును గుండ్రంగా చుట్టాము. ప్లాస్టర్ దానికి అతికించాము. ఆ తర్వాత వైరుకి ప్లగ్ ను పెట్టాము. ఒక మగ్గులో నీళ్లను పోసి మేము తయారు చేసిన వాటర్ హీటర్ ఆ నీళ్లలో పెట్టి స్విచ్ ఆన్ చేశాము. 20 నిమిషాల తర్వాత హీటర్ స్విచ్ ఆఫ్ చేశాము. నీళ్లు వేడిగా మారాయి. పొగలు కూడా ఎల్లాయి.మేము ఈ ప్రాజెక్టును ఇంట్లో పనికిరాని పదార్థాలతో తయారు చేశాము. మనం మార్కెట్లో డబ్బులు పెట్టుకొని అవసరం లేకుండా ఇలా పనికిరాని పదార్థాలతో ఇంట్లో తయారు చేసుకోవచ్చు.
problem_translated: Used household items cause pollution. Hot water is needed for bathing in winter.
solution_translated: First, we took a small wire. We took a brush used for painting walls, cut it a little, and put the wire inside it. We took out the main wire from inside and divided it into two parts. We wrapped those two parts around iron in a circular shape. We attached plaster to it. After that, we attached a plug to the wire. We poured water into a mug, placed the water heater we made into the water, and switched it on. After 20 minutes, we switched off the heater. The water became hot, and steam also came out. We made this project using waste materials from home. We can make this at home using waste materials without needing to spend money in the market.
summarization: The student identifies the need for hot water in winter and the issue of household waste. They propose a DIY water heater constructed from waste materials like a paint brush and wire. This homemade device successfully heated water, demonstrating a cost-effective and resource-efficient solution to provide hot water without market purchases.

Solution: బర్నర్ చుట్టూ కాపర్ ఘట్టాన్ని ఒక కాయిల్ లాగా పాత్ర నుంచుటకు ఇబ్బంది లేకుండా అమర్చవలెను ఈ కాయిల్ రెండు వైపులా ఒక ఇన్సులేటర్ వాటర్ ట్యాంకు అమర్చ వలెను ఇన్సులేటర్ ట్యాంకును స్టవ్కు దగ్గరగా, మనం వంట వండి పాత్రకు తగలకుండా అమర్చ వలెను ఇన్సులేటర్ ట్యాంకుకు ఒక టాప్ ను బిగించి వేడి నీటిని అవసరమైన వంట, ఇతర పనులలో ఉపయోగించుకోవచ్చు
problem_translated: Due to some heat being released into the surroundings from the flame, we observe the air around the burner and in the kitchen getting heated. Because of this, not only does our cooking get delayed, but a lot of LPG is also wasted.
solution_translated: A copper coil should be fitted around the burner in such a way that it does not hinder placing the vessel. An insulated water tank should be fitted on both sides of this coil. The insulated tank should be placed close to the stove, without touching the cooking vessel. A tap should be fitted to the insulated tank, and the hot water can be used for necessary cooking and other tasks.
summarization: The problem addresses the issue of heat escaping from the burner, which heats up the kitchen air, delays cooking, and wastes LPG. The proposed solution involves fitting a copper coil around the burner to capture this wasted heat. This heat would then be used to warm water in an insulated tank, providing hot water for other uses and improving cooking efficiency.

problem_translated: When using a gas cylinder, the amount of gas remaining in the cylinder is unknown, and gas leaks often go undetected.
solution_translated:
This product is designed to easily detect the amount of gas emptying in the cylinder and any leakage.

Product mechanism:
When the cylinder is placed on the load mount, the load cell beneath it sends the pressure to the HX711 amplifier. From there, it is sent to an Arduino Nano, which converts it into electrical signals. When transmitted to the LCD display, the amount of gas in the cylinder is shown on the screen in percentage form. Additionally, if there is any gas leakage from the cylinder and stove, to easily detect it, the gas sensor installed in this device absorbs the gas and immediately activates a buzzer sound and an LED light. This makes it easy to know that there is a gas leak, helping to prevent accidents.
summarization: The problem highlights the difficulty in knowing the amount of gas remaining in a cylinder and the danger of undetected gas leaks. The proposed solution is a device that uses a load cell and an Arduino to display the gas quantity in percentage on an LCD. It also includes a gas sensor that activates a buzzer and an LED light when a leak is detected, helping to prevent accidents.

Problem: ಗ್ರಾಮೀಣ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೃಷಿ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಬೇಸಾಯ ನಮ್ಮದಾಗಿದ್ದು ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಬಹುತೇಕ ಬೋರೆಲ್ ಗಳನ್ನು ಕೊರೆದಿದ್ದೇವೆ ಬೋರ್ವೆಲ್ ಮೋಟಾರ್ ಕೆಟ್ಟಾಗ ಅದನ್ನು ಹೊರ ತೆಗೆಯಲು ಮೊದಲು ಜನರನ್ನ ಅವಲಂಬಿಸಿದ್ದಿವಿ ಇದು ಜನರಿಗೆ ಹೊರೆಯಾಗುತ್ತಿತ್ತು ನಂತರ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಯಾಂತ್ರಿಕ ಮಷೀನ್ ತಯಾರಿಸಿದ್ದೀವಿ. ಇದು ಕರೆಂಟ್ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಇರುವಾಗ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುತ್ತಿರಲಿಲ್ಲ ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ನಾವು ಸೈಕಲ್ ಮೋಟಾರ್ ಇಂಜಿನ್ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಬೋರ್ ಮೋಟಾರ್ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೆತ್ತುವ ಸಾಧನವನ್ನು ತಯಾರಿಸಿದ್ದೇವೆ ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಯಾವುದೇ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ತಿನ ಅವಶ್ಯಕತೆ ಇಲ್ಲ ನಮಗೆ ಯಾವಾಗ ಬೇಕಾದಾಗ ಮೋಟಾರ್ ಇಂಜಿನ್ ಸ್ಟಾರ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಬೋರ್ ಮೋಟಾರ್ ಮೇಲೆ ಎತ್ತಬಹುದು
Solution: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಕೃಷಿಗೆ ನೀರಾವರಿ ಅತಿ ಅವಶ್ಯಕವಾಗಿದೆ ಆದರೆ ನೀರಾವರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬೋರ್ವೆಲ್ನಿಂದ ನೀರನ್ನು ಮೇಲೆ ಕೆತ್ತುವುದು ಅನಿವಾರ್ಯವಾಗಿದೆ ಇಂಥ ಸಂದರ್ಭದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾವು ಬರವಣಿಗೆ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಮೋಟಾರನ್ನು ಅಳವಡಿಸಬೇಕಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಆ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಮೋಟಾರ್ ಕೆಟ್ಟಾಗ ಅದನ್ನು ಹೊರ ತೆಗೆಯಬೇಕಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಹೊರ ತೆಗೆಯಲು ಅನೇಕ ಸಾಧನಗಳಿದ್ದರೂ ಅದು ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ಸಮಯಕ್ಕೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಬಳಸಬಹುದಾಗಿದೆ ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ನಾವು ತಯಾರಿಸಿದ ಈ ಒಂದು ಸಾಧನ ಒಂದು ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಮೋಟರ್ ಸೈಕಲ್ ನ ಇಂಜಿನ ವಾಗಿದ್ದು ಇದನ್ನು ಮೂರು ಕಬ್ಬಿಣದ ಕಂಬಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಲ್ಲುವ ಹಾಗೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಜೋಡಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ ಸೈಕಲ್ ಮೋಟಾರ್ ನ ಇಂಜಿನ್ ಸ್ಟಾರ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡಿದಾಗ ಬೆಲ್ಟ್ ನ ಸಹಾಯದಿಂದ ನಾವು ಮೊಟರನ್ನು ಮೇಲಕ್ಕೆ ಎತ್ತಬಹುದು ಮತ್ತು ಅತಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಇಂಧನದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾವು ಮೋಟಾರನ್ನ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೆತ್ತಬಹುದು ಮತ್ತು ಯಾವುದೇ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೆತ್ತಬಹುದು ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ವಿದ್ಯುತ್ ಅಥವಾ ಜಾಸ್ತಿ ಜನರ ಅವಶ್ಯಕತೆ ಇರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಇದು ಸಮಾಜಕ್ಕೆ ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಉತ್ತಮ ಸಾಧನವಾಗಿದೆ
problem_translated: In rural areas, our farming is agriculture-based, and we have drilled many borewells here. When a borewell motor breaks down, we initially depended on people to remove it, which was a burden on them. Later, we developed an electricity-based mechanical machine. However, it did not work when there was no electricity. Therefore, we have developed a bore motor lifting device based on a bicycle motor engine. This requires no electricity. We can start the motor engine and lift the bore motor whenever needed.
solution_translated: Generally, irrigation is very essential for agriculture, and in irrigation, lifting water from borewells is indispensable. In such situations, we need to install an electric motor. When that electric motor breaks down, it needs to be removed. Even though there are many devices for removal, they can only be used at specific times. Therefore, the device we have made is a small motorcycle engine, which is attached to three upright iron poles. When the bicycle motor engine is started, we can lift the motor with the help of a belt. We can lift the motor with very little fuel and at any time. It does not require electricity or many people. Therefore, this is a very good device for society.
summarization: The problem addresses the challenges faced by farmers in rural areas when borewell motors break down, as existing methods either rely on manual labor (which is burdensome) or electricity (which is unavailable during power cuts). The proposed solution is a bore motor lifting device powered by a small bicycle motor engine. This device operates without electricity, uses minimal fuel, and can be used at any time, reducing dependency on human labor and power supply.

problem_translated: Accidents were happening due to driver's negligence.
solution_translated: To make this device, we have built an automatic wiper using a rain drop sensor, a servo motor, an Arduino board, and a breadboard. Solution: ದಿನನಿತ್ಯ ನಮ್ಮ ಶಾಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಧ್ಯಾಹ್ನದ ಬಿಸಿ ಊಟ ಮತ್ತು ಬಾಳಿಯನ್ನು ನೀಡುವಾಗ ನಮ್ಮ ಶಾಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಇರತಕ್ಕಂತಹ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳು ಅವುಗಳ ಎತ್ತುವುದನ್ನೇ ನೋಡಿದ್ದೇವೆ ಅದೇ ರೀತಿ ಹೊಲಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬಹಳಷ್ಟು ಜನರು ವ್ಯವಸಾಯದ ವಸ್ತುಗಳನ್ನು ತರುವುದನ್ನು ನೋಡಿದ್ದೇವೆ ಇದರಿಂದ ನಾವು ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಗಾಡಿಯನ್ನು ತಯಾರಿಸಿ ಅದರ ಮೇಲೆ ಯಾವ ಬೇಕಾದ ವಸ್ತುಗಳನ್ನು ಒಂದು ಸ್ಥಳದಿಂದ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ಸ್ಥಳಕ್ಕೆ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಂಡು ಈಸಿಯಾಗಿ ಹೋಗಬಹುದು
problem_translated: When we saw many people around us carrying heavy objects, we felt the need to find a simple solution for it. The result is the pulling cart.
solution_translated: Every day, when hot lunch and water buckets are provided in our school, we have seen people in our school lifting them. Similarly, we have seen many people in fields bringing agricultural items. Because of this, we can make a small cart and easily transport any desired items from one place to another on it.

Problem: ಸರ್ಕಾರಕ್ಕೆ ಆರ್ಥಿಕ ಹೊರೆ ಗೇಟ್ ಮನ್ ಗಳ ಅಜಾಗರುಕತೆಯಿಂದ ವಾಹನಗಳ ಅಪಘಾತ ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತಿದ್ದವು ಹಗಲು ರಾತ್ರಿ ಎಲ್ಲ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲೂ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ
Solution:

  ಸ್ವಯಂ ಚಾಲಿತ ರೈಲ್ವೆ ಗೇಟ್ ಇದು ಸ್ವಯಂ ಚಾಲಿತವಾಗಿ ಗೇಟ್ ಹಾಕುವುದು ಮತ್ತು ಹೇಗೆಂದರೆ ನಾವು ರೈಲ್ವೆ ಗೇಟ್ನಿಂದ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ದೂರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಳವಡಿಸಿದ್ದೇವೆ ಅದು ಅಲ್ಲಿ ರೈಲು ಬಂದ ತಕ್ಷಣ ಸೆನ್ಸರ್ ಸೆನ್ಸ್ ಮಾಡಿ ಅದು ರೈಲ್ವೆ ಗೇಟ್ ಹಾಕುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ ನಂತರ ರೈಲು ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿ ದಾಟಿದ ನಂತರ ಅದರ ನಂತರದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಳವಡಿಸಿದ್ದ ಸೆನ್ಸರ್ ಸೆನ್ಸ್ ಮಾಡಿ ರೈಲ್ವೆ ಗೇಟ್ ತೆಗೆಯುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ ಇದರಿಂದ ಗೇಟ್ ಮನ್ಗಳ ಅವಶ್ಯಕತೆ ಇರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ ಮತ್ತು ಇದು ಹಗಲು-ರಾತ್ರಿ ಎರಡು ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುವುದರಿಂದ ರಾತ್ರಿ ವೇಳೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗೆಟ್ ಮನ್ ಗಳು ನಿದ್ದೆಗೆ ಜಾರುವ ಸಂದರ್ಭವಿತ್ತು ಆದರೆ ಇದು ಎಲ್ಲ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲೂ ಕಾರ್ಯನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ

problem_translated: The government faces a financial burden, and vehicle accidents were occurring due to the carelessness of gatekeepers (gatemen). Manual operation requires constant vigilance day and night.
solution_translated:
The equipment used to build the automatic railway gate includes an IR sensor, servomotor, Arduino board, buzzer, etc.
This automatic railway gate closes and opens automatically. We have installed a sensor a short distance from the railway gate. As soon as a train approaches there, the sensor detects it and causes the railway gate to close. After the train has completely crossed, another sensor installed after the gate detects it and causes the railway gate to open. This eliminates the need for gatekeepers. Since it operates day and night, it solves the problem of gatekeepers falling asleep at night, as it works continuously at all times.
This model can also be implemented in parking gates and house gates.
Problems occurred when gatekeepers fell asleep and during nighttime. The salaries of gatekeepers were also a financial burden on the government.
summarization: The problem addresses the financial burden on the government and vehicle accidents caused by careless gatekeepers, especially during night shifts. The proposed solution is an automatic railway gate system using IR sensors, a servomotor, and an Arduino board. Sensors detect an approaching train to close the gate and open it once the train has passed, eliminating the need for human gatekeepers and ensuring continuous operation.

Problem: ಕೆರೆಯ ಮಧ್ಯಭಾಗ ಅಥವಾ ನದಿಯ ಮಧ್ಯಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಕಸವನ್ನು ಸ್ವಚ್ಛಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ಅದನ್ನು ಸ್ವಚ್ಛಗೊಳಿಸಲು ಮಾನವನನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿದ್ದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವರ ಪ್ರಾಣ ಹಾನಿಯನ್ನು ತಪ್ಪಿಸಲು
Solution: ನಾವು ಒಂದು ಕೆರೆಗೆ ಭೇಟಿ ಕೊಟ್ಟಂತಹ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ಕೆರೆಯು ಮಧ್ಯಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಹಳ ಗಲೀಜು ಆಗಿರುವುದು ಕಂಡು ಬಂತು ಅವಾಗ ನಾವು ಆ ಮಧ್ಯಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಕಸವನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದುಹಾಕಲು ಈ ಮಾದರಿಯನ್ನು ತಯಾರಿಸಿದೆವು ಈ ಬ್ಲೂಟೂತ್ ಆಧಾರಿತ ಬೋಟ್ Andriod ಫೋನ್‌ನಿಂದ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ, ಅದು ರೋಬೋಟ್‌ಗೆ ಲಗತ್ತಿಸಲಾದ ಇತರ andriod ಮೊಬೈಲ್ ಫೋನ್‌ಗೆ ಬ್ಲೂಟೂತ್ ಸಂಪರ್ಕವನ್ನು ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಬ್ಲೂಟೂತ್ ಸಂಪರ್ಕವು ರೂಪುಗೊಂಡ ತಕ್ಷಣ, ಮೊಬೈಲ್ ಅಪ್ಲಿಕೇಶನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಯಾವುದೇ ಗುಂಡಿಯನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಿದರೆ, ಒತ್ತಿದ ಬಟನ್‌ಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ ಕೋಡ್ ಅನ್ನು ಬ್ಲೂಟೂತ್ ಮಾಡ್ಯೂಲ್‌ನ ಇನ್ನೊಂದು ತುದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ರೋಬೋಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಜೋಡಿಸಲಾದ ಬ್ಲೂಟೂತ್ ಸಹಾಯದಿಂದ ರೋಬೋಟ್ ಈ ಕೋಡ್ ಅನ್ನು ಗ್ರಹಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಿದ ಕೋಡ್ ಅನ್ನು ಬ್ಲೂಟೂತ್ ಮಾಡ್ಯೂಲ್ HC-05 ಸಹಾಯದಿಂದ ಮೈಕ್ರೋಕಂಟ್ರೋಲರ್ ಮೂಲಕ ಸಂಸ್ಕರಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಕೋಡ್ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯನ್ನು ಮೈಕ್ರೊಕಂಟ್ರೋಲರ್ಗೆ ಕಳುಹಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಮೈಕ್ರೊಕಂಟ್ರೋಲರ್ ಯಾವುದೇ ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್‌ಗೆ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಪ್ರೋಗ್ರಾಮ್ ಮಾಡಲ್ಪಟ್ಟಿದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಮೋಟಾರ್ ಡ್ರೈವರ್‌ಗಳಿಗೆ ಅದರ ನಿರ್ಧಾರವನ್ನು ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ ಮೋಟಾರ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಫಾರ್ವರ್ಡ್ ಅಥವಾ ಬ್ಯಾಕ್‌ವರ್ಡ್ ಚಲನೆ ಅಥವಾ ತಿರುವು ಮತ್ತು ಬಿನ್ ಮೂವ್‌ಮೆಂಟ್‌ಗೆ ಚಾಲನೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.
problem_translated: To clean the garbage in the middle of a lake or river and to prevent loss of human life if humans are used for cleaning it.
solution_translated: When we visited a lake, we found that the middle part of the lake was very dirty. Then, to remove the garbage in the middle, we made this model. This Bluetooth-based boat is controlled by an Android phone, which establishes a Bluetooth connection with another Android mobile phone attached to the robot. As soon as the Bluetooth connection is formed, if any button is pressed in the mobile application, the code related to the pressed button is received at the other end of the Bluetooth module. The robot perceives this code with the help of the Bluetooth module assembled in it. The received code is processed by the microcontroller with the help of the Bluetooth module HC-05. The code number is sent to the microcontroller. The microcontroller is programmed to make a decision for any input and outputs its decision to the motor drivers, driving the motors for forward or backward movement, turning, and bin movement.
summarization: This innovation aims to solve the problem of safely cleaning garbage from the middle of lakes and rivers, preventing human life loss. The solution is a Bluetooth-controlled boat operated by an Android phone. The phone sends commands via Bluetooth to a module on the robot, which then uses a microcontroller to drive motors for movement and garbage collection, effectively cleaning the water body remotely.

problem_translated: Electricity was wasted because lights were always on during daytime.
solution_translated: The main equipment used to prepare this model is IC LM555. When light rays fall on the LDR, an obstruction occurs, and the electrical resistance of the LDR increases. This causes a change in voltage, turning off the lights. Then, when it gets dark, the LDR stops receiving light. The circuit is then completed, and as voltage increases, all the lights turn on. This means that when there is light, the lights are off, and when it gets dark, the lights automatically start to glow. This prevents the unnecessary use of lights.
summarization: The problem addresses the wastage of electricity due to lights being left on during daylight hours. The proposed solution involves a circuit built with an IC LM555 and an LDR. This system automatically turns off lights when light is detected and turns them on when it gets dark, thereby preventing unnecessary energy consumption.

Problem: ನೀರನ್ನು ನೇರವಾಗಿ ಭೂಮಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರಾವರಿ ಮಾಡುವುದರಿಂದ, ಮಣ್ಣಿನ ತೇವಾಂಶದಲ್ಲಿನ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸದಿಂದ ಸಸ್ಯಗಳು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಒತ್ತಡಕ್ಕೆ ಒಳಗಾಗುತ್ತವೆ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಸಸ್ಯದ ನೋಟವು ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಸಿಸ್ಟಮ್ನ ಸ್ವಯಂಚಾಲಿತ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣದ ಅನುಪಸ್ಥಿತಿಯು ಅನುಚಿತ ನೀರಿನ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಗೆ ಕಾರಣವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
Solution:
ಕ್ಯೂಸ್ಮಾರ್ಟ್ ನೀರಾವರಿ...
 
 ಸ್ಮಾರ್ಟ್ ನೀರಾವರಿ ಹಲವಾರು ಸಮಸ್ಯೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪರಿಹರಿಸಲು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ, ಅವುಗಳೆಂದರೆ:

 ಸ್ಮಾರ್ಟ್ ನೀರಾವರಿ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಗಳು ಸಸ್ಯಗಳಿಗೆ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿರುವಾಗ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಪ್ರಮಾಣದ ನೀರನ್ನು ಒದಗಿಸುವ ಮೂಲಕ ನೀರಿನ ವ್ಯರ್ಥವನ್ನು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು. ಸಾಂಪ್ರದಾಯಿಕ ನೀರಿನ ವಿಧಾನಗಳು ಅತಿಯಾದ ನೀರುಹಾಕುವುದು, ಆವಿಯಾಗುವಿಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಅಸಮರ್ಥತೆಗಳಿಂದ 50% ನಷ್ಟು ನೀರನ್ನು ವ್ಯರ್ಥ ಮಾಡಬಹುದು.
 
 ಬೆಳೆ ಇಳುವರಿ

 ಪರಿಸರ ರಕ್ಷಣೆ
 
 ಸ್ಮಾರ್ಟ್ ನೀರಾವರಿ ಪರಿಸರ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆಗಳನ್ನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತು ನೀರನ್ನು ಕಾಪಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ
problem_translated: When water is directly irrigated into the soil, plants experience high stress due to variations in soil moisture, which reduces plant growth. The absence of automatic control in the system leads to an improper water control system.
solution_translated:
QSmart Irrigation...
 
Smart irrigation helps solve several problems, including:
 
Water wastage
Smart irrigation systems can reduce water wastage by providing the right amount of water to plants when needed. Traditional watering methods can waste up to 50% of water due to overwatering, evaporation, and inefficiencies.
 
Crop yield
Smart irrigation systems can improve crop yield and quality by providing optimal water to plants.
 
Environmental protection
Smart irrigation helps protect ecosystems and conserve water.
summarization: The current problem in irrigation is that direct watering leads to plant stress from inconsistent soil moisture and inefficient water use due to a lack of automatic control. The proposed solution, QSmart Irrigation, uses smart systems to deliver the right amount of water to plants, thereby reducing water wastage, improving crop yield and quality, and protecting the environment.

Problem:
1.அழுக்கான தயாரிப்பு சூழ்நிலை
 2.பாதுகாப்பு சேமிப்பு முறை
 3.மாசுபாடு
Solution:
அழுக்கான தயாரிப்பு சூழ்நிலைகள்: விவசாய மற்றும் உணவுப் பொருள் உற்பத்தியாளர் பகுதிகளில் சுகாதார நிபந்தனைகள் குறைவாக இருக்கும்போது,
 
 
 2. பாதுகாப்பான சேமிப்பு முறைகள்: உணவுப் பொருட்களைச் சரியாகச் சேமிக்காத போது, அவை தொற்று மற்றும் அழுக்கால் பாதிக்கப்படலாம். நிலைத்திருக்கும் காலத்தைக் கவனிக்காமல் உணவு பாதுகாப்பு குறைக்கப்படுகிறது.
 
 
 3. மாசுபாடு: pesticides, heavy metals, மற்றும் இவ்வாறான வேதியியல் பொருட்கள் உணவுப் பொருட்களில் உள்ளதால், மக்கள் உடல் நலத்திற்கு பாதிப்புகளை ஏற்படுத்தும்.
 
 
 4. உணவு போலிகள்: உணவுப் பொருட்களின் உண்மைத்தன்மையை உறுதிப்படுத்த முடியாத போது, மக்கள் மோசமான அல்லது பாதிக்கப்பட்ட உணவுகளை சாப்பிடுவார்கள்.
 
 
 5. உணவுப் பாதுகாப்பு விதிமுறைகள்: பல நாடுகளில் உணவுப் பாதுகாப்பு விதிமுறைகள் அல்லது நடைமுறைகள் குறைவாக இருக்கலாம், இதனால் பாதுகாப்பான உணவு கிடைப்பதற்கு கடினமாகிவிடுகிறது.
 
 
 6. பாரம்பரிய விவசாயம்: மூலிகை மற்றும் மரபுச்செல்வத்தைப் பயன்படுத்தாத விவசாயம், உயர் மாசுபாடு மற்றும் அழுக்கின் ஆபத்தை அதிகரிக்கிறது.
